skillSpector.unavailableDetails: The published assessment could not be loaded. This listing’s check status is unknown.
skillSpector.pluginScope: Scope: Skill files in this plugin. Other plugin components are not checked by SkillSpector.
skillSpector.absent: No published scan report matches this listing. A later automatic run may check it; no run time is confirmed.
skillSpector.disclaimer: This report covers only the listed Skill files at the recorded revision. It does not run code or guarantee safety.
skillSpector.unverified: The current revision of this listing has not been verified.
skillSpector.empty: No findings were reported by the completed static checks.
skillSpector.selected: Only a selection of catalog sources is checked.
skillSpector.older: This report is historical or describes a different source revision or analysis policy. It does not establish the current state.
skillSpector.staticParseLimit: Some expressions exceeded the static parser’s limits.
skillSpector.referenceMissing: Some local file references were not found in the scanned Skill files; they may be created at runtime.
skillSpector.analyzerIncomplete: An analyzer did not complete all planned checks.
skillSpector.pendingCoverage: {checked} of {total} selected skills checked. Remaining skills are waiting for a background check.
skillSpector.adviceConfirmed: A material issue has been confirmed. Review the evidence and remediation before installing.
skillSpector.adviceReview: Review the reported signals and their context before installing. Automated findings have not been confirmed by a reviewer.
skillSpector.adviceComplete: The completed static checks reported no content findings. Review the source and requested access before installing.
skillSpector.adviceUnknown: This report cannot establish the current state. Review the source and requested access before installing.
skillSpector.unsupportedDetails: No supported Skill files were available for this static check. This says nothing about other plugin components.
skillSpector.pendingDetails: No current scan report has been published for these Skill files. A later automatic run may check them; no run time is confirmed.
skillSpector.legacyCoverage: Legacy report: complete plugin coverage and current policy checks are not established. Existing partial results remain partial.
skillSpector.signalExplanation: Severity describes a potential impact. Confidence is the scanner’s estimate; neither confirms an issue.
skillSpector.signalCounts: {groups} finding groups · {signals} content signals · {raw} raw scanner findings
skillSpector.classificationExplanation: This classification is a narrowly matched registry rule, not a human security audit.
skillSpector.limitedGroups: The published report contains only the displayed groups. The total number of distinct findings is unknown.
skillSpector.skillRemoved: The previously checked Skill file was removed at the newly examined source revision. The old report remains available as history; no current content was checked.
skillSpector.acquisitionTransferLimit: Source retrieval reached this scan profile’s transfer limit. Files that were not retrieved were not inspected.
skillSpector.loadingAdvice: SkillSpector is loading. Coverage is unknown; review the source before installing.
skillSpector.referenceScope: References and runtime-created files outside the inspected source remain unverified. Missing references describe coverage limitations, not confirmed security findings.
skillSpector.contextTruncated: Context is limited: {references} of {referencesTotal} references and {diagnostics} of {diagnosticsTotal} diagnostics are shown.
skillSpector.unsupportedSourceDetails: This source type is not supported by static SkillSpector checks. Its files have not been checked.
skillSpector.checkUnavailableDetails: The source could not be checked. Coverage is unknown; review the reported reason before installing.
skillSpector.noSkillsDetails: This plugin does not include Skills. SkillSpector checks Skill files only; other plugin components are outside its scope.
skillSpector.title: Skill scan
skillSpector.engine: SkillSpector performs static checks of the source files.
skillSpector.retryblocked: Follow-up checks blocked: {count}. Review the reasons below.
skillSpector.statusExplanation: A result may have gaps if some files or checks could not be verified. This does not mean a security issue was confirmed.
skillSpector.awaitingExplanation: These listed Skills do not have a current result yet. Their safety is not known.
skillSpector.referenceUninspectedArtifact: Some referenced files or directories were not fully inspected. See their original paths and coverage limits.
